data.why: The repo ships no example CSVs (only generation scripts needing LLM APIs), so these three files mirror the exact admin-upload schemas (conv_id/topic/source/text/qid/question/answer/translated_question; unique_id/role; sender_id/conv_id) with a healthcare/everyday mix and one row with a missing answer to exercise the importer's handling of blanks.

goals: Populate the study with source conversations (prompts plus reference Q&A pairs) that senders will enact and have translated
Provision role-based participant accounts (sender, receiver, validator) and obtain their self-signup links
Assign specific conversations to senders via a conversation-entry import, bootstrapping the sender -> translation -> receiver -> validator pipeline
Monitor study progress and per-role task completion from the admin dashboard
Export a conversation-entry snapshot for downstream speech-translation usability analysis

review.summary: The tree covers the coordinator side of an Ouvia study well, from loading conversations and enrolling roles to assigning, monitoring and exporting, and its features are well cut and grounded in the screens. But the participant pipeline that measures speech-translation usability (record, translate, answer, validate, survey) appears only as previews, two cited screens don't show what their nodes claim, and two trivial phases should be merged, so it needs fixes before it is filed.
